script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Workplace
Theme: second chances

Begin screenplay.

---

FADE IN:

INT. MILLER TECHNOLOGIES - DAY

A LARGE, OPEN-PLAN OFFICE. CUBICLES FILL THE SPACE.

Our HERO, JAMES (30s, nerdy, but kind), sits in the center of the room. He types furiously on his computer, eyes focused intently.

Around him, COLLEAGUES hustle and bustle. Some chat with one another, while others make phone calls.

The MANAGER, CHARLES (50s, stern, but fair), enters and approaches James' cubicle.

---

CHARLES
(looking concerned)
James, we've got a problem. A big one.

JAMES
(looking up, worried)
What is it?

---

CHARLES
(sighs)
Our latest project, the one we've all been working on for months, has hit a snag. The client wants some major changes. And fast.

---

JAMES
(nervously)
I'll do my best, Charles. I won't let the team down.

---

CHARLES
(puts a hand on James' shoulder)
I know you won't, James. But this time, I'm going to need you to do more than just your best. I need you to go above and beyond.

---

James nods, determined.

---

INT. MILLER TECHNOLOGIES - KITCHEN - LATER

James stands in the kitchen, surrounded by his colleagues. He's holding a cup of coffee, looking at his laptop.

ELIZABETH (30s, confident, ambitious), a coworker, approaches him.

---

ELIZABETH
(leaning against the counter)
You look stressed.

---

JAMES
(sighs)
I am. We've got a major issue with the latest project.

---

ELIZABETH
(smiles)
I heard. But I have an idea.

---

INT. MILLER TECHNOLOGIES - DAY

James and Elizabeth present their idea to Charles. He listens intently, nodding in approval.

---

CHARLES
(smiling)
That just might work. James, I want you to lead this new direction. And Elizabeth, you'll be working closely with him.

---

JAMES
(nervously)
Me? But I've never led a project before.

---

CHARLES
(puts a hand on James' shoulder)
I believe in you, James. And I know you won't let me down.

---

James looks at Elizabeth, then back at Charles, nodding in determination.

---

INT. MILLER TECHNOLOGIES - NIGHT

James sits at his desk, late into the night. Elizabeth works alongside him, occasionally offering suggestions.

---

ELIZABETH
(looking at her watch)
It's getting late. You should go home and get some rest.

---

JAMES
(shaking his head)
I can't. We're so close to a solution.

---

ELIZABETH
(smiling)
Then we'll keep working.

---

INT. MILLER TECHNOLOGIES - MORNING

The sun rises, casting a warm glow over the office. James and Elizabeth work tirelessly, fueled by coffee and determination.

---

INT. MILLER TECHNOLOGIES - DAY

The team gathers around as James presents the new direction for the project. There are a few tense moments, but ultimately, everyone is on board.

---

CHARLES
(clapping)
Well done, James. And Elizabeth, your contributions were invaluable.

---

ELIZABETH
(smiling)
We made a great team.

---

JAMES
(looking at Elizabeth, a newfound respect in his eyes)
We did.

---

FADE OUT.
